reference_and_coefficients: Unchanged from prior committed 206-sample v4 NNLS results
cutpoint: Keep global all-206 median=0; High>0, Low=0; no re-cutting after clinical exclusions
main_eligibility: Exact full tumor ID minus final T; clinical SAMPLE_ID equals patient ID; also match an earlier GSE54504 Tumor(full ID) sample; GEO age equals clinical AGE. No inferred L/H alias matching.

primary_endpoints.DFS: Source DFS_MONTHS and 0:DiseaseFree / 1:Recurred; not PFS; no rewriting deaths as DFS events

time_validation: Finite positive months and valid explicit event labels; no DFS event after a known death; flag OS-living last-follow-up shorter than DFS follow-up instead of substituting times
comparisons: Two-sided logrank and High-vs-Low Cox HR with 95% CI; BH across the two primary logrank tests
continuous_model: NNLS coefficient z-scored on all 206 original expression samples; HR per SD
adjustment: Sensitivity Cox models adjusted for age only; no invented sex/stage covariates. Grade IIII, CIRRHOSIS numeric and incorrect LIAD labels are retained as unmodified source data and not used as adjustment variables.
sensitivity_analyses: Include both age-discordant IDs (198 exact-ID matches)
Exclude the one living-OS/DFS follow-up discordant sample from DFS only
Two predeclared expression-transform alternatives; same frozen coefficients and median-based grouping; no outcome-based choice
source_label_conflict: All 231 source sample rows say LIAD/Hepatocellular Adenoma, in conflict with authoritative GSE and linked original HCC study; scope follows original HCC study and GEO IDs, flag source label issue rather than filtering all patients out.
secondary_Cox_multiplicity: BH across all 8 target-coefficient tests (2 endpoints x 4 models), excluding nuisance age-coefficient tests; secondary family explicitly separate from primary logrank family
